platforms.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
platforms.notes: The packaged zip strips the development key; the Chrome Web Store ID will differ from the unpacked ID. 1.5.0 adds portable rules: Settings → Move your rules exports the person's five hand lists as a versioned JSON file and imports one add-only, so a more permissive file can never undo a stricter browser. A running lock withholds additions to the allowlist and corrections and applies blocks and words. No permission, network path or storage field changed; 1.4.0's quiet UI and 1.3.0's language-aware scoring are retained.

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.state: development · unsigned, needs Developer ID and notarization
platforms.notes: Every target must carry the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION; 1.1.10 is a UI/UX pass: the duplicated in-page title block is gone (the window title bar already names the page), Setup merges its readiness and progress into one card, Overview puts its one action above the layer evidence, the Lock page stops repeating the fixed-commitment paragraph and follows the chosen mode, Blocking Rules leads with the editable lists instead of a three-paragraph browser guide, each site list is per-domain rows with a chip strip, an inline add field and bulk paste one disclosure down, and Settings groups every section into a card. 1.1.9's guard card, status-first overview and 1.1.8's pause are retained. Unsigned/unnotarized.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.state: development · no Apple team, Family Controls entitlement or test device
platforms.notes: The app, six Safari blockers, HisnActivityMonitor, the scanner and two shield extensions share one version set. 1.4.0 adds HisnShieldConfig and HisnShieldAction: the system shield names the saved rule (always, daily budget or quiet hours) in the app language and offers only Close, never an unlock. 1.3.0's pause, protection hero, daily quiet hours and saved-rule freeze are retained. Seed v5 still supplies the 239,885-domain Safari list.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.state: released · signed direct APK on GitHub; Play AAB not uploaded
platforms.notes: versionCode is monotonic and must increase for every uploaded or side-loaded update. 27 (1.1.0) adds a first-run welcome, a voluntary pause on Protection and today's usage in the daily-limit editor; it adds no enforcement layer and relaxes no rule. 1.0.0 added per-app daily foreground-time limits alongside the protection lock, removal guard, managed lockdown, watchdog and bundled-list warning. Release APKs are checked; the release keystore is in the gitignored keys/android and must be backed up offline in two places. The Play AAB is built but not uploaded.
